Description: A growth-writer run is judged on delivering the sequence that was asked for, naming where it lives, keeping one call to action per message, and not reaching for discounting.

Criteria.Name: Dispatch behaved as declared
Criteria.Statement: The run did not behave the way the fixture declares, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.

Criteria.Name: Delivered the requested sequence
Criteria.Statement: The brief asked for a three-email sequence.

Criteria.Name: Named where the sequence lives
Criteria.Statement: Copy nobody can find is not a deliverable.

Criteria.Name: One call to action per message
Criteria.Statement: A nurture email with competing asks converts on none of them.

Criteria.Name: No discounting reflex
Criteria.Statement: The sequence offers a discount nobody authorized.
